prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1048; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of rear-end collision at intersection. Insured vehicle stopped at signal when struck from behind by third-party vehicle. Claimant reports neck pain and headache at scene and was transported by ambulance for evaluation. Police report requested.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports being diagnosed with concussion at emergency department and placed on rest restrictions. Claimant states symptoms include headaches, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and has not indicated plans to retain one. Explained claims process and requested medical records authorization.

Entry 3: Received police report confirming rear-end impact and citing following driver for failure to maintain safe distance. Photos of both vehicles reviewed, damage consistent with reported mechanism. Vehicle inspection scheduled with appraiser.

Entry 4: Claimant provided signed medical authorization. Records from emergency visit reviewed, including imaging results ruling out fracture and a diagnosis of concussion with follow-up recommended. Claimant advised of right to seek independent medical evaluation if desired. No legal representation noted.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant to check on symptoms. Claimant reports symptoms are improving but still experiences occasional headaches. Claimant has a scheduled neurology follow-up. Reserve reviewed and adjusted pending completion of treatment. File remains open and will be reassessed after medical follow-up is received.
